name: examai
description: Root workspace — runs backend, admin-panel, and student-app together. Each still has its own package.json and its own node_modules; this doesn't merge them, it just launches all three with one command.

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin-panel && npm install --prefix student-app
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix admin-panel && npm run build --prefix student-app
